audio.text: Why are you so tired today?

options: It's a really nice day for a walk.
I studied until two last night.

why.en: "Why" → a reason. A answers "Yes"; B gives a time; C repeats "day" without answering.
why.tr: "Why" → bir neden. A "Yes" diyor; B zaman veriyor; C "day" kelimesini cevap vermeden tekrar ediyor.
why.es: "Why" → una razón. A responde "Yes"; B da un momento; C repite "day" sin responder.
